command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$control = $PSScriptRoot
$app = Join-Path (Split-Path $control -Parent) 'kanji-cards-android'
$runner = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'runner.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($runner.status -ne 'running' -or $runner.sessionId -ne 'bea27fce-cb1d-46d6-b96d-9ea11da66963') {
    throw 'Unexpected supervisor session.'
}
$ancestor = $PID
$supervisorIsAncestor = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10 -and $ancestor -gt 0; $i++) {
    if ($ancestor -eq $runner.pid) { $supervisorIsAncestor = $true; break }
    $process = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$ancestor"
    if (-not $process) { break }
    $ancestor = $process.ParentProcessId
}
if (-not $supervisorIsAncestor) { throw 'Recorded supervisor is not this coordinator ancestor.' }
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot'
$env:ANDROID_HOME = 'C:\Users\stop-\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk'
Set-Location $app
$started = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
$started.ToString('o') | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'batch-056-android-start.txt') -Encoding utf8NoBOM
Write-Output "FRESH056_STARTED=$($started.ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "CONTENT_ROOT=$([IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $app 'core') '..\..\learning-japanese')))"
& .\gradlew.bat :core:test --tests 'io.github.stopcran.kanji.core.RealContentTest' :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests 'io.github.stopcran.kanji.core.RareHanTest' --no-daemon --no-parallel --max-workers=1 --rerun-tasks '-Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process' --init-script C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace\control\batch-049-host-integration-heap.init.gradle 2>&1 |
    Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $control 'logs\execution-320-android.txt')
$result = $LASTEXITCODE
$result | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'logs\execution-320-android-exit.txt') -Encoding utf8NoBOM
Write-Output "FRESH056_EXIT=$result"
exit $result
